items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Weighs Options For Its $671 Million Private Credit Portfolio
items.summary: BlackRock (NYSE: BLK) is exploring the sale of TCP Capital's US$671 million private credit loan portfolio as part of a reshaping of the asset vehicle. The potential divestiture marks a further step in BlackRock's adjustments within private credit under current market conditions. This move could affect how BlackRock structures future private credit vehicles and how TCP Capital stakeholders view the portfolio. items.title: SharpLink’s Ethereum Treasury Draws 60% Institutional Ownership
items.summary: SharpLink is getting deeper into the institutional spotlight. Institutional ownership of the Ethereum treasury company has climbed to around 60%, according to the company, with major names including Fidelity, BlackRock, Morgan Stanley, Vanguard, State Street, Invesco and Highbridge Capital Management among its institutional holders. The increase comes as SharpLink continues to build its Ethereum treasury
